profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Transmit, Consulting Software Architect
profile.summary: Accomplished Principal Software Engineer and Software Architect with 30+ years of experience designing and developing commercial software across a wide range of platforms, including mobile devices, desktops, and cloud environments. Expertise in crafting highly performant algorithms and scalable microservices, with a strong focus on applications requiring deep mathematical, statistical, and computational knowledge. Proven track record of innovation, including contributions to multiple patents. Adept at solving complex technical challenges and driving architectural excellence across diverse industries.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Penthera offers innovative solutions for ad monetization and mobile video viewing:

2ndLook: Faster video startup times and improved monetization for ad-supported VOD using Server-Side Ad Insertion.
Penthera Download: Managed solution for secure and reliable offline mobile video playback.
Download for AVOD: Managed solution for offline video playback with dynamic ad support and measurement.

I design and implement features for an SDK that manages downloads of very large (GB-sized) video from the cloud to iOS and Android mobile devices devices with full support for client side and server side AVOD; develop cloud based Server-Guided Ad Insertion services to provide just-in-time ad insertion for ad-supported publishers using Server-Side Ad Insertion; author tutorials for customers demonstrating SDK features and programming best practices; assist support staff with customer questions and diagnosing mission critical issues; and provide prototypes and proof of concept applications to management supporting development of new products and features.

Technologies: iOS, Objective-C, Swift, Android, Kotlin, Java, Micronaut, MongoDb, Docker.

positions.title: Consulting Software Architect
positions.description:
Argolytics provides software solutions for manufacturing's toughest challenges, including Trendable an online application that creates powerful, accurate SPC and Cpk reports.

I am responsible for selecting technologies, languages, and infrastructure to build applications for statistical process and quality control; designing the software architecture, modules, and components utilizing Google Cloud Functions and the Firebase Realtime Database; providing a security strategy to protect intellectual property and user data; and developing algorithms and implement routines for control charts and capability analyses.

Technologies: node.js, javascript, Firebase, Google Cloud Functions

positions.title: Consulting Software Architect
positions.description:
AgIntegrated is a leading provider of both custom and off-the-shelf precision agriculture applications and agriculture information management systems. 

I developed microservices using Azure Function Apps and Service Bus to receive and analyze grower/farm/field data. Constructed core libraries for advanced GIS data analysis including Kriging, thin plate spline, Delaunay triangulation, and Voronoi interpolation methods; vector/raster transformations and resampling; projection transformations; and polygon rendering. Designed a cloud-based data warehouse to facilitate ETL processing of grower/farm/field data.  

Technologies: C#, Azure Function App/Service Bus/Blob Storage, Mono, C/C++, PostgreSQL, PHP, JavaScript, AWS, GIS, GPS

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
I designed and developed commercial data analysis software. Mentored development staff on software best practices.  Acted as liaison between Software Engineering and Technical Support to address customer software issues.

Developed the dialog framework for Minitab using XML, IActiveScript, MFC and COM. Added data analysis features supporting Design of Experiments, including creation, analysis, and graphics related to Factorial, Response Surface, Mixture, and Taguchi Designs.  Devised and implemented libraries to import/export Excel, CSV/text, spreadsheet XML, SQLite and ODBC data into/from Minitab.  Created COM component to license all Minitab software.  Led effort to localize and internationalize software.

Technologies: C/C++, FORTRAN, C#, Objective C, Windows SDK, MFC, ATL, COM, Boost, STL, .Net

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was hired by Omnicomp, a small company recently purchased by Enron, to create new functionality for an energy management and energy accounting application called FASER.  Development was done in Borland C/C++ and OWL.

I also worked on MeterReader, converting it from OWL to the original Windows CE mobile platform.

Technologies:  C/C++, OWL, Windows CE

positions.title: Director of Information Systems
positions.description: I implemented the Agency's first in-house computer system, instructing staff at six offices on operation of all software and hardware.  Acted as liaison between Agency and hardware, software, and telecommunication vendors.  Supervised entry of patient data and ensured HCFA compliance.  Generated ad hoc reports and analyses from Agency data.
